Light the flame to open the map of Westeros.

The Realm

Level 1, 0 of 5 seats held

Start at Dragonstone: choose a dragon to ride, then strike the Eyrie first. The other seats unlock once it is captured.

Dragonstone: home of the dragons

Every dragon lives at Dragonstone and stays here. Tap Shrykos, glowing at the bottom right, to begin.

The realm is yours

All five seats bend the knee. You reach level 7, and Balerion the Black Dread is yours to ride.
